A '''Sullustan''' [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] was brainwashed by agents of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]. The [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] attempted to crash a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], but was stopped by another Sullustan officer.
